svg.title: Stereo mixer 28HP panel - drill template (print at 100%)
svg.text: Stereo mixer 28HP panel, front view. Red circles: final hole size. Centre-punch the crosses, pilot-drill 2 mm, then step up.
Toggles (ATE1D/ATE2D) have no panel nut: the board holds them. Check the lever swings freely in 5 mm; open up if it rubs.
